keykeeperExpiringItemsReportDesc.message: Items that have expired or expire in the next 30 days: API keys, certificates, licenses, cards, and anything you set an expiration date on.

keykeeperNoExpiringItems.message: Nothing in your vault has expired or expires in the next 30 days.

keykeeperExpiringItemsFoundDesc.message: These items have expired or expire in the next 30 days. Renew or rotate them, then update their expiration dates.

keykeeperVersionsUnreadable.message: Earlier versions that can't be opened: $COUNT$

keykeeperRestoreVersionDesc.message: The item goes back to how it was on $DATE$. How it is now stays in its version history, so you can come back to it.

keykeeperVersionSameAsNow.message: This version looks the same as the item does now.

keykeeperVersionHistoryWhoSees.message: Everyone who can open this item can see its earlier versions, including old passwords.

keykeeperVersionHistoryHiddenPasswords.message: You can't see this item's passwords, so its earlier versions show only when they were saved and by whom.

keykeeperClearHistoryDesc.message: Its earlier versions are deleted for everyone who can open it. The item stays as it is now.

keykeeperDeleteVersionDesc.message: The version from $DATE$ is deleted for everyone who can open this item.

keykeeperClearedHistoryItemId.message: Cleared the earlier versions of item $ID$.

keykeeperDeletedVersionItemId.message: Deleted an earlier version of item $ID$.

keykeeperManageAccountRecoveryHint.message: Can reset the master password of members in account recovery, and so sign in as them and see everything they can.

keykeeperImportExportHint.message: Covers import. Exporting the organization's vault needs access to all items, which custom roles can't have yet.

keykeeperCustomRoleNoCollections.message: With these permissions, a custom role can't also manage all collections yet. Give them collections on the Collections tab.

keykeeperBiometricsNotEnrolled.message: Unlock with biometrics is still off. It wasn't confirmed, or the desktop app isn't running.

keykeeperSelfHostedAddressHint.message: Your server's address, such as vault.example.com.

keykeeperAccessIntro.message: Who can open each shared folder, and how. Owners and admins see every item. Everyone else opens the shared folders they're given, directly or through a group. Someone who reaches a folder two ways gets the more open permission, and passwords stay hidden only if every way hides them.

keykeeperAccessHiddenFolder.message: 1 shared folder isn't shown, since you can't open it yourself.

keykeeperAccessHiddenFolders.message: $COUNT$ shared folders aren't shown, since you can't open them yourself.

keykeeperAccessSearch.message: Search people, groups, and shared folders

keykeeperAccessEveryItemPeople.message: Also open to everyone who sees every item: $NAMES$.

keykeeperAccessOnlyEveryItemPeople.message: Only people who see every item can open it: $NAMES$.

keykeeperAccessNoFoldersYet.message: This organization has no shared folders yet.

keykeeperAccessLoadFailed.message: Couldn't load who can see what. Reload the page to try again.

keykeeperCanViewHidden.message: Can view but not see passwords

keykeeperCanEditHidden.message: Can edit but not see passwords

keykeeperReachFoldersRevoked.message: Before they were revoked, $NAME$ could open $FOLDERS$ with $ITEMS$.

keykeeperReachEveryItem.message: $NAME$ can see every item in this organization: $ITEMS$.

keykeeperReachEveryItemRevoked.message: Before they were revoked, $NAME$ could see every item in this organization: $ITEMS$.

keykeeperReachNoFoldersRevoked.message: Before they were revoked, $NAME$ couldn't open any shared folders.

keykeeperReachNeverConfirmed.message: $NAME$ was never confirmed, so they never had the key to this organization's items.

keykeeperSeenPasswordsIntro.message: $NAME$ could see these logins' passwords in the shared folders they could open. They may still know them, so change them.

keykeeperSeenPasswordsEveryItem.message: $NAME$ could see every item in this organization, so they may know any of its passwords.

keykeeperSeenPasswordsOtherItems.message: Other items they could see, such as notes and cards, aren't listed.

keykeeperSeenPasswordsNotAgain.message: This list won't be shown again, so copy it if you'll need it later.

keykeeperSeenPasswordsAccessLink.message: See who can open each shared folder
